operations.title: No nonempty finite Euler cutoff is a self-adjoint xi determinant
operations.statement: A finite intrinsic-prime determinant has local zero lattices s=2pi ik/log p on Re(s)=0, which map under s=1/2+iz to nonreal zeros on Im(z)=1/2. Its inverse Euler product is meromorphic. Archimedean completion does not cancel the nonzero lattices. Hence no finite prime cutoff is a self-adjoint determinant approximation.
operations.scope: Exact no-go for all nonempty finite Euler cutoffs; genuinely global renormalized infinite completion remains possible.
